name: Pay2.House Standard Virtual Card
summary: A multi-currency virtual debit card designed for high-limit online payments and team-based media buying with instant issuance.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the Pay2.House Standard Virtual Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: Yes — it charges US$5 per month. Card issuance is US$5.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Pay2.House Standard Virtual Card?
faq.answer: It charges about 2% on non-base-currency spending.
